## When add room
```
When api.PostAsJsonAsync("/rooms", new Room(the RoomNumber, an int))
```

### Given no such room

#### Then point at the new room
```
Then Result.Headers.Location.ToString() is "/rooms/{the RoomNumber}"
```

#### Then respond created
```
Then Result.StatusCode is HttpStatusCode.Created
```

#### Then return the room
```
Then Result.Read<Room>() is new Room(the RoomNumber, the int)
```

### Given the room already exists
```
Having api.PostAsJsonAsync("/rooms", new Room(the RoomNumber, any int))
```

#### Then respond conflict
```
Then Result.StatusCode is HttpStatusCode.Conflict
```

## When get room
```
When api.GetAsync("/rooms/{the RoomNumber}")
```

### Given no such room

#### Then respond not found
```
Then Result.StatusCode is HttpStatusCode.NotFound
```

### Given the room exists
```
Having api.PostAsJsonAsync("/rooms", new Room(the RoomNumber, an int))
```

#### Then respond ok
```
Then Result.StatusCode is HttpStatusCode.OK
```

#### Then return the room
```
Then Result.Read<Room>() is new Room(the RoomNumber, the int)
```

## When list rooms
```
When api.GetAsync("/rooms")
```

### Given no rooms

#### Then respond ok
```
Then Result.StatusCode is HttpStatusCode.OK
```

#### Then return no rooms
```
Then Result.Read<Room[]>() is empty
```

### Given two rooms
```
Having api.PostAsJsonAsync("/rooms", new Room(a second string, a second int))
  and api.PostAsJsonAsync("/rooms", new Room(a string, an int))
```

#### Then respond ok
```
Then Result.StatusCode is HttpStatusCode.OK
```

#### Then return both rooms in the order they were created
```
Then Result.Read<Room[]>() has two items that first is
      new Room(the string, the int)
Second is new Room(the second string, the second int)
```
